headlines.description: — Connor McDavid scored on a short-handed breakaway and set up Ryan Nugent-Hopkins’ power-play score, helping the Edmonton Oilers beat the Boston Bruins 3-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor McDavid scores short-handed, sets up power-play goal in Oilers' 3-1 win over Bruins

headlines.description: — Zachary Bolduc scored twice and Lane Hutson had three assists as the Montreal Canadiens beat the Chicago Blackhawks 4-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zachary Bolduc scores twice as Canadiens beat Blackhawks 4-1

headlines.description: — Linus Ullmark made 24 saves for his first shutout of the season, Brady Tkachuk scored twice and the Ottawa Senators beat the Pittsburgh 4-0 on Thursday night to extend the Penguins' losing streak to seven.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ullmark makes 24 saves in 4-0 victory as Senators hand Penguins 7th straight loss

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Adrian Kempe scored twice in the second period, and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 2-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kempe scores twice in 2nd period as Kings beat Lightning 2-1 to snap 4-game skid

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Logan Thompson earned his second shutout of the season, Jakob Chychrun scored twice and the Washington Capitals rebounded from a pair of ugly losses, beating the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Capitals rebound from a bad road trip, beat Maple Leafs 4-0 behind goalie Thompson

events.name: Minnesota Wild at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Kirill Kaprizov and Matt Boldy each had a goal and two assists, and the Minnesota Wild beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 5-2 on Thursday night for their sixth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaprizov, Boldy each have a goal and two assists as Wild beat Blue Jackets 5-2 for 6th straight win

headlines.description: — Tage Thompson and Noah Ostlund scored 2:36 apart in the closing minutes of the second period, and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Philadelphia Flyers 5-3 on Thursday night for their fourth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thompson, Ostlund score 2:36 apart late in 2nd period as Sabres beat Flyers 5-3 for 4th straight win

events.name: New York Rangers at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — J.T. Miller scored 2:21 into overtime and the New York Rangers beat the St. Louis Blues 2-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: J.T. Miller scores in OT to give Rangers 2-1 win over Blues

headlines.description: — Mikael Backlund had two goals, and the Calgary Flames scored three times in the third period to beat the Seattle Kraken 4-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Backlund scores twice as Flames use 3-goal 3rd period to beat Kraken 4-2

events.name: Dallas Stars at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Wyatt Johnston scored twice and the Dallas Stars beat the San Jose Sharks 5–3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wyatt Johnston scores 2, Roope Hintz has goal and assist as Stars beat Sharks 5-3
